name: @hmcts/rpx-xui-core-lib
description: Shared EXUI core library: repository foundation for selective browser loading and Node services.

scripts.test: mkdir -p test-results && node scripts/check-repository.mjs && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=tap --test-reporter-destination=test-results/validation.tap tests/validation.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: rm -rf test-results && mkdir -p test-results && yarn build && yarn lint && yarn test:reporters && yarn test:contracts && yarn test:compatibility:contracts && yarn test && yarn test:node && yarn test:i18n && yarn test:package && yarn build:host && yarn test:browser:support && yarn test:browser && yarn test:cache-upgrade && yarn check:contracts && node tests/reporters/odhin-site-publisher.cjs --check-source test-results/odhin
scripts.test:node: rm -rf test-results/node-unit test-results/node-jest.json && tsc -p tests/node/tsconfig.json && jest --config tests/node/jest.config.mjs --runInBand --json --outputFile=test-results/node-jest.json
scripts.test:cache-upgrade: node --test tests/cache-upgrade-source-mismatch.test.mjs && node scripts/build-cache-upgrade.mjs && playwright test -c tests/cache-upgrade/playwright.config.mjs
